label: Scalar
description: A single numerical value, often representing magnitude without direction.

label: Vector
description: An object defined by magnitude and direction, represented as an ordered list of numbers.

label: Matrix
description: A rectangular array of numbers arranged in rows and columns, used in linear algebra.

label: Tensor
description: A generalization of scalars, vectors, and matrices to higher dimensions.

label: Derivative
description: Measures the rate of change of a function with respect to its input.

label: Integral
description: Represents accumulation of quantities, often visualized as the area under a curve.

label: Limit
description: The value a function approaches as the input approaches a point.

label: Series
description: The sum of terms in a sequence, often infinite.

label: Convergence
description: The property of a sequence or series approaching a finite value.

label: Divergence
description: When a sequence or series grows without bound or fails to settle to a value.

label: Probability
description: The measure of likelihood that an event will occur.

label: Random Variable
description: A variable whose values are determined by chance.

label: Distribution
description: Describes how probabilities are assigned to possible outcomes.

label: Mean
description: The average value of a set of numbers.

label: Median
description: The middle value in a sorted list of numbers.

label: Mode
description: The most frequently occurring value in a dataset.

label: Variance
description: A measure of how spread out values are around the mean.

label: Standard Deviation
description: The square root of variance, indicating average distance from the mean.

label: Set
description: A collection of distinct objects considered as a whole.

label: Subset
description: A set whose elements are all contained within another set.

label: Function
description: A relation that assigns each input exactly one output.

label: Domain
description: The set of all possible inputs for a function.

label: Range
description: The set of all possible outputs of a function.

label: Graph
description: A structure of nodes and edges used to model relationships.

label: Topology
description: The study of properties preserved under continuous deformation.

label: Prime Number
description: A natural number greater than 1 with no divisors other than 1 and itself.

label: Factorial
description: The product of all positive integers up to a given number.

label: Combinatorics
description: The study of counting, arrangements, and combinations.

label: Algorithm
description: A step-by-step procedure for solving a problem or computation.

label: Complex Number
description: A number with a real part and an imaginary part, written as a + bi.
